theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_fd_lz_boundary_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (T T' : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R R' : IMRep U (m + 1)) (t₀ : ℝ), closedBall (0 : Euclid P) t₀ ⊆ V → R.Represents T → R'.Represents T' → R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ ball (0 : Euclid P) t₀ → R'.mult = R.mult → R'.orient = R.orient → T'.boundary.mass ≤ 2 * T.boundary.massOn V + 2 * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * R.measure {x : Euclid P | t₀ - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t₀}) (𝓝[>] 0)
